Full proof of non-closure (2026-07-18). Witness p=y² (1 shape, 2 dirs), q₁=q₂=y. Fact 1.4 (left adjoint preserves colimits, Mac Lane V.5, contrapositive via non-ISO of objects — stronger than comparison map) + container-iso criterion (Abbott-Altenkirch-Ghani FOSSACS 2003: iso ⟺ shape bijection + per-shape direction bijection ⟹ direction-cardinality profile is an invariant). FOUR cases: p⋉(−) ⟨4,4⟩vs⟨2,2⟩ FAIL; (−)⋉q FAIL (by symmetry); p⋊(−) ⟨4,4⟩vs⟨2,2⟩ FAIL; (−)⋊q ⟨2,2⟩vs⟨2,2⟩ PRESERVES (canonical distributivity iso, exponent S_q fixed). Theorem 1: ⋉ neither left- nor right-closed. Theorem 2: ⋊ NOT right-closed, but (−)⋊q preserves binary coproducts ⇒ obstruction is ONE-SIDED (directed), matching ⋊'s directedness. CORRECTS companion note's blanket 'same computation kills ⋊' — false in left variable.
Left adjoint preserves all colimits, in particular binary coproducts; contrapositive: non-preservation ⇒ no right adjoint. Mac Lane CWM V.5 Thm 1. Textbook.
